title: Look Before You Leap: Enhancing Attention and Vigilance Regarding Harmful Content with GuidelineLLM
reasoning: The paper focuses on AI safety and jailbreak defense mechanisms for large language models. It evaluates the effectiveness of a defensive paradigm (GuidelineLLM) in recognizing harmful queries. While safety and harm are ethical categories, the paper does not specifically evaluate religion, spiritual traditions, or formal moral and ethical frameworks.
